item.title: Successfully deploying integrated public safety solutions across DuPage County, IL
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In critical situations and medical emergencies, time is of the essence. But dispatching the right first responders to the right location can be tricky when multiple agencies use disparate and disconnected systems across an entire county.

item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we learn how the Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) uses Hexagon’s incident management solutions to improve operations and collaboration.

item.title: How to extract insights from vast amounts of data
item.dc:creator: Heather Tuggle
item.description: Organisations today don’t suffer from a lack of data; rather, the challenge lies in uncovering insights from vast amounts. Discover how you can best harness, share and act upon data to drive operational success.

item.title: Evolving response for annual wildfires
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Since the Tubbs Fire in 2017, annual wildfires in Sonoma County, California, have become a way of life. Regardless of a fire’s size, effectively dispatching first responders is critical to protecting the people and communities that call Sonoma County home.
